summary: First-party Saudi cadastral/geospatial services were found and bounded public routes were inspected. The National Geospatial Platform advertises land parcels, REGA advertises parcel maps and spatial search, and the Ministry describes Urban Maps/U Maps parcel display. No safe anonymous native parcel ID plus full polygon was retrieved, so runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Arabic discovery queries, exact text, outcomes, and actual result URLs are recorded in city-1608-ash-sharai.json.
requestOutcomes: TLS-verified GET of the National Geospatial Platform landing page returned HTTP 200; its current React HTML referenced /Geoportal/static/js/main.c4b26dc9.js, which was retrieved HTTP 200 and inspected for service/configuration strings. TLS-verified GET of the official National Geospatial Platform description returned HTTP 200 and explicitly listed land parcels. The Ministry Urban Maps page returned HTTP 200 and directs users to Balady/U Maps, describing streets and land parcels. The REGA geospatial portal returned HTTP 503 to a direct GET during this attempt, although its official page was available in first-party discovery and describes parcel layers/search. The public geoportal catalog landing URL returned HTTP 200, but no feature-service endpoint or safe parcel response was obtained.
